description: Get the reproduction context from a TraceBug bug report: plain-English steps, structured user actions (with rage/dead-click frustration signals), and the session timeline (paged: 100 events per call by default).

file.description: The report to read: a path to a TraceBug export file (.html), absolute or relative to the server's base directory — or just the filename, or a fragment of the filename or report title. Get exact paths from list_bug_reports.

limit.description: Items per call (default 100, max 500). Long text fields are clipped to 4,000 characters.

offset.description: Skip this many items (default 0). Use the nextOffset a previous call returned.

name: get_repro_steps
